scope: Refresh exact peer release, issue, PR, and application-engine lineage evidence for plot settings, ACIS DXF writing, and HATCH/polyline DWG consumer acceptance; update only existing plan owners.

method.kind: Primary-source web review plus read-only local plan/source/test inspection
method.limitations: Peer issue and PR content is reporter/contributor evidence, not a libdxfrw reproduction. The strict third-party reader named in OpenCADStudio issue #570 is not identified in the issue report. No external attachment was downloaded and no peer release was tested.

sources.observed: Issue #1184 remains open and its detailed reproductions identify 3.6.35 and 3.6.51; the release page lists v3.8.0, but this review did not establish a repro or fix status for that version. PR #1240 remains open without review/deployment evidence on the page, depends on #1174, and reports an ACDSDATA multi-310 readback problem after the refactor. #1195 is a writer-side omission report, not a released ACIS writer capability.
sources.planUse: Retain mode-aware plot-DPI handling under PAR-111/7BM; do not project the old-version issue onto v3.8.0. Keep #1240 experimental and the ACIS entity/carrier/owner/semantic/native evidence lanes separate.

sources.observed: DXF code 78 is only applied when code 77 is Custom (5); the documented active Custom DPI range is 100 through 32767.
sources.planUse: Preserve inactive/raw values on import, validate only active Custom output, and keep the existing destination-preservation/retry controls.

sources.observed: OpenCADStudio issue #570 was closed after its maintainer reported that a current-main R2018/2026.41 output opened without recovery in an unnamed strict third-party reader and produced no LibreDWG errors. OpenCADStudio identifies ACadRust as its native DWG/DXF engine, so the app is not an independent parser lineage; the independent reader is unnamed and its report was not reproduced.
sources.planUse: Use the scenario only to sharpen the optional composed test: locally create closed-polyline plus HATCH controls; separate associative/non-associative variants; bind app and engine revisions; record a named independent reader, recovery/audit/erasure, identity/owner closure, and repeated save/reopen behavior. Do not use or commit the attached customer DWG.
